text:
Priya R: Starting my shift — quick handoff. Two active incidents: inc-4572 (eu-west1 embedding latency spike) and inc-4573 (us-central KV cache evictions). Mitigations applied below, leaving monitoring and a few asks.

oncall-bot: New incidents created: inc-4572, inc-4573 (auto).

Marcus L: Ack. reading dashboards now. do we have regen fallbacks enabled for web-tier?

Priya R: Yes, regen fallback is enabled. Router fallback = model redwood-small-v2, canary rollout on 10% traffic. Model pinned to commit `c4f2b9a` to avoid surprises.

Kai T: I saw the spike at ~02:12 UTC — KV cold misses jumped. Bumped prefetch and started a node drain on shard-3 to rebalance. Running:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/kv-cache --selector=shard=3
```
should bring back healthy replication.

Marcus L: Thanks. Any user-facing 5xxs? I can route a quick status note if needed.

Priya R: Small blip of 502s for a couple of minutes, peaked at 1.2% — dropped after eviction tuning and the restart. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.prod/inc/4572. Target: keep 5xx < 0.5% for next hour.

Sasha M: FYI I have a PR that fixes an NPE in the embedding ingest path (PR #842). It reduces retry storms on misses. Requesting @Marcus L for review when you have a minute.

Marcus L: ping received, will review in ~10m.

Priya R: Operational next steps:
- Autoscaler pinned for kv-cache: min=3 -> desired=5 nodes until 08:00 UTC.
- Keep the fallback routing active; rollback canary if p95 latency > 200ms for 5m.
- If requeues > 20/min escalate to infra oncall.
Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/kv-evictions-runbook

Kai T: ACK. I'll monitor p95 and requeues and will roll back canary if thresholds breach.

oncall-bot: incident inc-4572 status changed to acknowledged by Priya R.

Priya R: Leaving handoff to Kai at 07:30 UTC. If anything spikes ping the thread and page infra. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Marcus L: thx, good handoff.

Sasha M: thanks — will follow up on the PR.

Kai T: taking over, monitoring now.
